subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding rate as a comparison of two different units (e.g. speed, price per item)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tracks a virtual object's movement over time to find its speed rate
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured price tag/quantity pair and states the rate
exercise.abstract: Student calculates a rate (unit price, unit speed) from given quantities

misconception_flags: confuses ratio (same units) with rate (different units)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
